topic: Manual and computerized Accounting Processing Systems

questions.q: In a computerized accounting processing system, the posting of journal entries to individual ledger accounts and the generation of the trial balance are typically
options: Performed manually by accounts clerks at the end of each month
Executed automatically and instantaneously by the software once transaction data is inputted
Conducted exclusively by external auditors during the end-of-year statutory audit
Completely eliminated because ledgers are not required in computerized accounting
questions.explain: In a **computerized accounting system**, once source transaction data (like an invoice or receipt) is keyed in, the system automatically posts the entries to the relevant ledger accounts, updates balances in real time, and extracts the trial balance instantly without requiring manual posting by clerks.
